meta.title: Engram · Your Anki decks, studied out loud
meta.description: Android app that turns your AnkiDroid decks into realtime voice study sessions with an AI tutor. No streaks, no gamification. Your review queue, walking.

hero.title:

hero.subtitle: Not a quiz. A conversation. The tutor asks you a card, listens to how you explain it, and tells you what's missing. You learn by formulating, not recognizing.

features.sectionTitle: A tool. Not an EdTech app.
features.sectionSubtitle: We don't gamify studying. We don't sell you content. We wire your AnkiDroid to a tutor that has a conversation about your cards instead of quizzing you.

items.title: Real semantic evaluation
items.description: Synonyms, reordered words, natural paraphrase. All fine. No textual match required. If in doubt, you can override the tutor's call without breaking FSRS scheduling.

items.title: Topic-agnostic decks
items.description: Medicine, dev, languages, law, cloud certifications. Works with any AnkiDroid deck. We don't ship predefined content.

items.title: Hands-free, eyes-free
items.description: Android foreground service. Session keeps running with the screen off. Walking, washing dishes, at the gym. Never while driving.

items.title: Your audio doesn't touch our backend
items.description: A direct connection between your phone and the model. Our server only mints the ephemeral session token. We don't store audio, process it, or relay it.

items.title: Studies in any language
items.description: Set the tutor's language per deck. A Spanish deck in Spanish, a Japanese deck in Japanese. Gemini Live's native multilingual audio switches automatically.

items.title: Anki stays the source of truth
items.description: We read via ContentProvider. We don't edit your cards, don't change your deck options, don't break your AnkiWeb sync. Anki is the respected older sibling.

howItWorks.sectionTitle: What studying without a screen feels like.
howItWorks.sectionSubtitle: Four gestures. None after the second.

steps.title: You grant permissions once
steps.description: Microphone and AnkiDroid ContentProvider. No email signup, no tutorial about what a flashcard is.

steps.title: You pick a deck
steps.description: Your decks with due cards are listed. You tap one. Put your headphones on and put the phone away.

steps.title: You talk to the tutor
steps.description: It reads the card, hears your answer, grades it, moves on. Voice commands: repeat, skip, pause, override.

steps.title: Results flow back into Anki
steps.description: Again, Hard, Good or Easy based on the evaluation. Your FSRS keeps running like nothing happened.

pricing.lede: Voice APIs cost money. We say it directly because we'd rather you understand where the dollars go.

trial.note: No card. No email signup. Try it, and subscribe only if it actually earns your time.

pricing.antiDarkPattern: No "are you sure you want to cancel?". No hidden cancel button. No extra charged month. The day you cancel, cancel.

items.question: Does it modify my Anki collection?
items.answer: No. We read via ContentProvider and write back Again, Hard, Good or Easy results, exactly as if you had tapped them in AnkiDroid. Cards, note types, deck options and your AnkiWeb sync stay untouched.

items.question: What if the AI grades me wrong?
items.answer: Say "mark correct" or "mark wrong" and the result is overwritten. If manual overrides go above 10% the product is broken. It's a metric we monitor.

items.question: Does this break my FSRS scheduling?
items.answer: No. The session result enters AnkiDroid as a normal review. FSRS processes it with the exact same logic as any other. Your scheduling stays intact.

items.question: Where does my audio travel?
items.answer: Directly from your phone to Gemini. Our backend only mints the ephemeral session token. No audio is stored. You can audit it: traffic never hits our server.

items.question: Does it work offline?
items.answer: No. The tutor is an online model. If you lose signal mid-session, the session pauses and resumes automatically when connection returns. Everything you answered is saved.

items.question: iOS?
items.answer: Not yet. The AnkiDroid integration is Android-only (AnkiMobile on iOS doesn't expose a ContentProvider). iOS comes after we validate the product.

items.question: Can I use it while driving?
items.answer: No. Not in any situation. We will never promote it for car, motorcycle or bicycle. The use case is walking, cooking, washing dishes, gym. Places where a second of attention isn't fatal.

items.question: Why do I pay if I'm bringing the API?
items.answer: You're not bringing it. The $5 subscription includes the sessions, we pay the Gemini consumption. That's why there's a daily cap: without it, the API cost would exceed the price.
